callout.kicker: Why nothing has been bet yet
callout.body: TAB's cut on these games is 4.28–5.53%; the US books work on 2–3%. So every bet here starts behind before we've even looked at the two teams. The one advantage we can find is a price TAB hasn't got around to updating.
